surprises: NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S1: pip on this Windows interpreter cannot have its per-user config redirected by environment, so candidate (b) is measured as the PIP_CONFIG_FILE config file
NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S2: the dead-loopback index candidate (c) is graded FAIL by the zero-request rule because the proxy listener logs its attempt
NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S3: the positive arm reaches the proxy listener, and no pip arm reaches the index listener
NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S4: read literally, the wrapper's allowed list lets four argument shapes make requests, so the kit refuses them beyond the list
NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S5: the verbatim wrapper refusal text names the laptop, which collides with the no-box-name rule
NFRA_CTLPLN-W63-S6: pip retries a 502 by default, so the kit appends --retries 0 --timeout 5 to every pip command it starts
